description: Synthetic demo fixture for the Cyclone Fani 2019 T-24h replay. All spatial values (hazard, exposure, susceptibility) are deterministic approximations generated by pipelines/fani/generate-demo-fixture.ts using documented Fani event parameters as a basis. Infrastructure asset locations are curated from publicly known facility locations in Odisha. This fixture enables the engine and UI to operate without running the GEE preprocessing pipeline.
evaluationWarning: SYNTHETIC — DO NOT use to generate claimed historical accuracy metrics
parameterBasis: IMD RSMC Post-Cyclone Report — Very Severe Cyclonic Storm FANI (2019): https://rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in
Landfall time: ~0500 UTC 3 May 2019, near Puri, Odisha
Peak wind: ~250 km/h; at T-24h: ~220 km/h
Documented storm surge: ~3.5m (IMD/INCOIS reference; scenario uses 1.5m as T-24h estimate)
Approximate 2019 settlement populations from Census of India publications
Road network based on approximate NH-16 alignment
Infrastructure locations based on publicly known facilities in Odisha
replacementGuide: To replace with real data: (1) run pipelines/gee/ scripts to produce WorldPop/NASADEM/GPM exports; (2) run pipelines/osm/ to extract January 2019 infrastructure; (3) replace cells.geojson with GEE-derived outputs; (4) update infrastructure.json from OSM extract; (5) set dataStatus to REAL_DATA and synthetic to false in this file. The engine contracts (TypeScript types + Zod schemas) do not change.
